notes: Registration names identify exact old parameterized families; their original source remains in entry_revision Git objects.
Pure free-proof, witness and destructor-capability verdicts have no current semantic equivalent. They are retired explicitly, not disabled.
Mixed families keep operand order, null/bounds failure order, exceptions, initialization, dispatch, resource/pool behavior, artifacts and allocation assertions in place.

Two retained mixed families were additionally migrated: ConstructionPublicationTests preserves all dispatch/publication shapes as accepted managed source; FilesystemServicesTests keeps typed/native operations while destructor-only rejection is retired.
File-tree callback retention becomes accepted managed behavior, with gc7_retained_visitor plus unchanged depth/link/abrupt-close controls.

TCP old malloc-block/free totals are retired as managed-reclamation evidence. Descriptor balance/native fault checks remain; heap interposer totals are observations. Metrics fifth field now measures source-close allocations, expected zero.
Steady-state zero-allocation/live-delta controls remain when the workload performs no collection or allocation.

Pool-builder origin replacements reject direct, explicit-super and implicit-super constructor publication and unknown/cached factory effects; quiet constructors and ordinary managed publication remain accepted.

Final BridgeRetentionAnalyzer audit deletes unproduced PERMANENT origin, unused cleanupBodies rejection stub and String ownership-result queries. All live analyses continue to include initialization and conservative foreign effects.
